pythonEnvironment: Project-local .venv; global Python packages are unchanged
cache: Project-local model-cache; official checkpoint SHA256 is verified
submitEndpoint: POST /tasks with multipart fields image and kind
supportedInput: Transparent PNG or WebP. Automatic photo-background segmentation is not installed.
output: Self-contained GLB with neural shape and baked neural RGB UV texture. Roughness and metalness are explicit renderer defaults, not predicted PBR maps.
stops: Ctrl+C stops the local HTTP service. A remote service is never used as a quota workaround.
preserves: The original scene plan is not sent to the model and is never modified by this service. Layout binding and placement remain the frontend's responsibility.
